mono.purpose: Identifiers, versions, paths, resource values, and technical data.

shadows.name: dark-soft
shadows.purpose: Dark-theme elevated cards and quiet floating panels.

shadows.name: light-soft
shadows.purpose: Light-theme elevated cards and quiet floating panels.

motion.name: state-standard
motion.purpose: Borders, surfaces, and color changes for operational controls.

motion.name: control-lift

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Compact high-intent command for scan, apply, confirm, and other meaningful operations.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 32px; padding: 0 13px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; background: linear-gradient(150deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary) 86%, #8ee7ff 14%), color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary) 74%, #1767a2 26%)); color: var(--color-primary-content); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.01em; transition: transform 140ms ease, filter 160ms ease; box-shadow: 0 8px 18px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary) 40%, transparent), inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, #ffffff 34%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); filter: saturate(105%); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Quiet secondary command with a structural border and a primary-aware hover state.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { height: 32px; padding: 0 13px; border: 1px solid var(--borderColor); border-radius: 10px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--dockrev-surface) 88%, transparent); color: var(--text); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.01em; transition: transform 140ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary) 42%, var(--borderColor) 58%); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--dockrev-surface-strong) 88%, transparent); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Operational Input
components.description: Compact theme-aware field for operational filters, settings, and structured inputs.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 280px; max-width: 100%; height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid var(--borderColor); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--panel2); color: var(--text); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 12px; outline: none; transition: border-color 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary) 30%, var(--borderColor) 70%); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: Desktop shell navigation row with a distinct primary-tinted active state.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; gap: 6px; width: 220px; padding: 14px; background: var(--panel2); font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-nav a { display: flex; align-items: center; height: 44px; padding: 0 13px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 590; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 160ms ease, background-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-nav a:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--dockrev-surface-strong) 88%, var(--panel2) 12%); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--borderColor) 75%, var(--color-primary) 25%); color: var(--text); } .ds-nav .ds-nav-active { background: linear-gradient(128deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary) 22%, var(--panel2) 78%), color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary) 12%, var(--panel2) 88%)); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary) 42%, var(--borderColor) 58%); color: var(--text); font-weight: 640; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary) 28%, transparent); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Operational Card
components.description: Layered container for dense service, status, and maintenance information.
components.css: .ds-card { display: grid; gap: 6px; min-width: 220px; padding: 14px; border: 1px solid var(--borderColor); border-radius: 16px; background: linear-gradient(160deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--panel) 92%, var(--color-primary) 8%), color-mix(in srgb, var(--panel) 96%, var(--panel2) 4%)); color: var(--text); font-family: var(--font-sans); box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft); } .ds-card strong { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 670; } .ds-card span { color: var(--muted2); font-size: 12px; }

components.name: Theme Preference
components.description: Segmented preference control for choosing the product's semantic light or dark presentation.
components.css: .ds-theme { position: relative; display: grid; width: 180px; min-width: 132px; height: 42px; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--borderColor) 76%, transparent); border-radius: 12px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--dockrev-surface) 88%, transparent); overflow: hidden; font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-theme-thumb { position: absolute; top: 3px; bottom: 3px; left: calc(33.333% + 1px); width: calc((100% - 6px) / 3); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary) 46%, var(--borderColor) 54%); border-radius: 9px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary) 16%, var(--panel2) 84%); } .ds-theme button { position: relative; z-index: 1; min-width: 44px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--muted); font: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-theme button:hover, .ds-theme .ds-theme-active { color: var(--color-primary); } .ds-theme button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: -2px; }

narrative.overview:
Dockrev is an operational interface for people working directly with Docker Compose services. It is a compact control surface: service state, version information, resource signals, actions, and outcomes must stay easy to scan while an operator is making a maintenance decision.

Dark is the default working theme, with a calm blue-black shell and restrained cyan signal color. A complete light theme mirrors the same information hierarchy for daylight use and personal preference; changing theme alters the palette, never the meaning of status or action. Both themes avoid a marketing or observability-poster feel in favor of durable admin-tool conventions.
keyCharacteristics: A responsive app shell with compact navigation, top-bar context, and dense operational content.
Theme-aware semantic tokens for action, information, success, warning, error, text, surface, and border.
Small, deliberate controls and stable data layouts for repeated maintenance work.
Status and risk are represented with text, icons, and color rather than color alone.
Focus, disabled, reduced-motion, and narrow-screen behavior are part of the shared interaction language.

rules.name: Semantic Signal Rule
rules.body: Primary and status colors communicate action or state. They are not decorative fill.

rules.name: Theme Parity Rule
rules.body: Dark and light themes retain the same semantic roles, hierarchy, and interaction affordances.

rules.name: Dense Sans Rule
rules.body: Keep the primary hierarchy in the shared sans stack; do not introduce decorative display or serif typography into product routes.

rules.name: Layer Before Shadow Rule
rules.body: Establish hierarchy with a surface, border, and spacing before adding shadow.

rules.name: One-Pixel Trace Rule
rules.body: Borders remain thin traces; operational status does not use thick colored stripes as decoration.

rules.name: Theme Pair Rule
rules.body: Use the matching `light-` primitive when a component is rendered in the light theme. Dark tokens are the default primitives; the runtime's semantic aliases select the equivalent light tokens without changing action or status meaning.

dos: Do keep pages compact, dense, and scannable for repeated maintenance work.
Do use the semantic state roles consistently in both themes.
Do keep real, stale, disabled, unknown, and failed states explicit.
Do maintain visible keyboard focus and usable 320px-to-desktop layouts.
Do place high-intent actions beside the service or job evidence that supports the decision.
donts: Don't turn authenticated operational routes into marketing landing pages.
Don't use color or decorative status in place of truthful operational data.
Don't introduce a generic dashboard card grid where structured rows or grouped service data are clearer.
Don't add neon, purple-gradient, glass-first, or oversized decorative styling as product identity.
Don't let dark and light themes diverge in status meaning, interaction affordance, or information hierarchy.
